name: Hawaii

flag.description: Eight horizontal stripes repeating white, red and blue from the top, with the Union Jack in the canton.
flag.symbolism: The eight stripes stand for the eight main islands; the Union Jack recalls the Hawaiian Kingdom's early friendship with Britain.

hook: Hawaii is the only US state wearing the Union Jack, over eight white-red-blue stripes, one for each main island.
trivia: It is the only US state flag to include the flag of another country.
The same flag has flown over Hawaii as a kingdom, a republic, a US territory and a state.
